intro: I'm Kummep Ringpon Timyil — Kummep Jnr — a **full-stack developer**, **IT technician** and **geology graduate** of the University of Jos. I build web apps for clients, make maps for people who need to understand the ground, and fix the computers in between.
quote: The present is the key to the past — and good software, like good geology, is about reading the layers carefully.
story: I studied **geology** at the University of Jos, graduating in 2025. Field mapping exercises took me across the Jos Plateau — Kanam, Wase, Mazah, Miango, Barkin Ladi — and my industrial training with the **Nigerian Geological Survey Agency (NGSA)** put me on real field teams collecting stream sediment samples and writing reports.

For my final-year project I independently mapped **14 km²** of Basement Complex terrain around Wulmi, Pankshin, at 1:12,500 scale, combining structural analysis with thin-section petrography — and identified pegmatites as targets for **lithium, beryl and gemstones**, and fractured zones as potential aquifers.

Alongside geology, I've been freelancing in **software** since 2023: building web apps with Django, Flask, FastAPI, React and Next.js, deploying them with Docker, and working as an **IT technician** — installing systems, repairing hardware, setting up networks and recovering data.

Today I'm serving my NYSC year with the Department of Geology at **Modibbo Adama University, Yola**, supporting final-year research students and training my host community in digital skills — while taking on development and **GIS mapping** work on the side.

principles.title: Observe first
principles.description: Like logging an outcrop, I start by understanding the problem and the data before writing code or drawing a map.

principles.title: Ship, then refine
principles.description: A working version beats a perfect plan. I iterate quickly based on real feedback from clients.

principles.title: Sweat the details
principles.description: Clear map layouts, loading states and edge cases matter as much as the logic behind them.

principles.title: Teach what I know
principles.description: Whether it's final-year students or a digital literacy class, sharing skills is part of the job.

beyond: I'm a student member of the **Nigerian Mining and Geosciences Society (NMGS)** and the **Nigerian Association of Petroleum Explorationists (NAPE)**. My research interests are igneous and metamorphic petrology, structural geology, pegmatite mineralization, and **GIS and remote sensing** in geological mapping.
I speak English, Hausa and Taroh, and I'm always open to projects that bring **software** and **earth science** together.
connectText: Need a web app, a map, or a geologist on your team — or just want to say hi? I'd love to hear from you.
